plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash.
Add QQQI to 15% to boost income allocation.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall risk.
Expect lower volatility and a more conservative growth profile.
conservative.read: This mode aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and increasing cash. Drawdowns should be minimal, but upside potential is also capped.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to minimal levels.
Maintain a small position in leveraged METU.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and increase cash buffer.
Buy DDOG and SMCI, both strong scanner setups, to add growth potential.
This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This mode targets approximately 2.5% monthly return with a risk-first approach to growth. It trims leverage and concentration while adding promising new names. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate, with a focus on steady progress.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs SOXL, MUU, METU, and SPAL.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and free up capital.
Buy DDOG and SMCI, adding significant exposure to top scanner setups.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by leaning into leverage and concentration.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This mode targets aggressive growth of around 4% monthly, accepting higher risk for greater upside. It maximizes leverage and concentration in strong performers and top scanner setups. Be aware of amplified losses, leverage decay, and the potential for substantial drawdowns.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, METU, SPAL) to zero.
Trim high-beta single names CRWD and SNOW to reduce volatility.
Significantly increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash buffer.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income and capital preservation over growth.
income.read: This mode focuses on generating consistent monthly income with a target of around 1% return. It minimizes risk by eliminating leverage and high-beta names, favoring income-focused ETFs. While distributions are prioritized, NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
